abilities.name: Fresh Meat
abilities.description: Upon dying, nearby enemy Minions drop 1 Fresh Meat and enemy Heroes drop 20 Fresh Meat. Fresh Meat can be picked up to gain 0.5 Attack Damage per Meat. The Butcher loses 15 Fresh Meat upon dying. quest Collect 200 Fresh Meat. Gain an additional 125 Attack Damage and 25% increased Attack Speed. Heroes continue to drop 10 Fresh Meat, Minions no longer drop Fresh Meat, and Fresh Meat is no longer lost on death.

fields.notes: Attack Speed stacks additively with other effects affecting the Butcher's Attack Speed. Bonus Attack Damage from Fresh Meat is added to The Butcher 's base Attack Damage before multiplying by the sum of any damage modifiers, such as Brutal Strike and Nexus Blades.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Deal 110 damage and Slow enemies by 50% fading over 2 seconds. The Butcher's next Basic Attack will strike immediately.

abilities.name: Butcher's Brand
abilities.description: Deal 37 damage to an enemy and Brand them for 4 seconds. The Butcher's Basic Attacks against the Branded target heal him for 75% of the damage done. Basic Attacks against Branded Heroes heal for double and extend the duration of the Brand by 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Resets The Butcher's Basic Attack timer.

abilities.name: Ruthless Onslaught
abilities.description: Charge at an enemy, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed. If The Butcher reaches the target, they are Stunned for 1 second and take 119 damage.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Status effect
fields.props: Mobile channel, Movement speed, Stun, Unstoppable
fields.notes: The Butcher is not Unstoppable until the cast time is complete, meaning that, like other Abilities, it can interrupted by enemy crowd control during its windup, refunding its cooldown and Mana cost. Ruthless Onslaught can be reactivated after 0.75 seconds to interrupt the charge, placing it on full cooldown. Otherwise The Butcher is uncontrollable during the charge. Charge is automatically canceled if it has been active for 4 seconds without hitting the target or if the target becomes untargetable or, for its windup, if the target moves farther than 5 units from its maximum cast range.

abilities.name: Furnace Blast
abilities.description: After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 damage to enemies. Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

abilities.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
abilities.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: 'Nearest enemy' refers to the one closest to the center of the search area. Chained enemies will be pulled to the center if they try to escape the area.

talents.name: Invigoration
talents.description: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.
_raw_fields: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

talents.name: Block
talents.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 2 charges.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.
